headline: Play Quake in your browser using only HTML and CSS
summary: A developer has recreated the classic first-person shooter using inspectable HTML and CSS, powered by PolyCSS. No installation required.
details: CSSQuake brings the iconic 1990s first-person shooter Quake directly to your web browser. The project leverages PolyCSS to render the game's visuals entirely through HTML and CSS.

This innovative approach allows users to play Quake without any need for downloads or installations. The game's elements are presented as inspectable HTML and CSS code, offering a unique look into its rendering.

The project showcases the power and flexibility of modern web technologies, demonstrating how complex graphical experiences can be achieved using standard web development tools. It's a nostalgic trip for gamers and a technical marvel for developers.

While the gameplay might differ from the original experience, CSSQuake offers a fascinating and accessible way to revisit a piece of gaming history. It's a testament to creative coding and the enduring appeal of classic titles.
